JSON Index: Replace the original board index with one supporting searching, sorting, infinite scrolling, and a catalog mode.
Use 4chan-XZ Catalog: Link to 4chan-XZ's catalog instead of the native 4chan one.
Index Refresh Notifications: Show a notice at the top of the page when the index is refreshed.
Follow Cursor: Image Hover and Quote Preview move with the mouse cursor.
Open Threads in New Tab: Make links to threads in the index / 4chan-XZ catalog open in a new tab.
External Catalog: Link to external catalog instead of the internal one.
Catalog Links: Add toggle link in header menu to turn Navigation links into links to each board's catalog.
Desktop Notifications: Enables desktop notifications across various 4chan-XZ features.
404 Redirect: Redirect dead threads and images to the archives.
Archive Report: Enable reporting posts to supported archives.
Exempt Archives from Encryption: Permit loading content from, and warningless redirects to, HTTP-only archives from HTTPS pages.
Time Formatting: Localize and format timestamps. Has more options on the "Advanced" tab.
Comment Expansion: Expand comments that are too long to display on the index. Not applicable with JSON Index.
Index Navigation: Add buttons to navigate between threads.
Reply Navigation: Add buttons to navigate to top / bottom of thread.
Unique ID and Capcode Navigation: Add buttons to navigate to posts having the same unique ID or capcode.
Custom Board Titles: Allow editing of the board title and subtitle by ctrl/⌘+clicking them.
Persistent Custom Board Titles: Force custom board titles to be persistent, even if the board titles are updated.
Show Updated Notifications: Show notifications when 4chan-XZ is successfully updated.
Color User IDs: Assign unique colors to user IDs on boards that use them
Count Posts by ID: Display number of posts in the thread when hovering over an ID.
Reveal Spoilers: Indicate spoilers if Remove Spoilers is enabled, or make the text appear hovered if Remove Spoiler is disabled.
Normalize URL: Rewrite the URL of the current page, removing slugs and excess slashes, and changing /res/ to /thread/.
Disable Autoplaying Sounds: Prevent sounds on the page from autoplaying.
Disable Native Extension: 4chan-XZ is NOT designed to work with the native extension.
Enable Native Flash Embedding: Activate the native extension's Flash embedding if the native extension is disabled.
Export History: Export last read, your posts, etc. when exporting the setting
Ask to Export History: Ask if history should be exported when settings are exported.
Scroll Markers: Mark your posts and replies to them on the scroll bar. Relies on the "Highlight Posts Quoting You" and "Highlight Own Posts" settings

Linkify: Convert text into links where applicable.
Link Title: Replace the link of a supported site with its actual title.
Link Title in the catalog: Replace the link of a supported site with its actual title in the catalog too. Speed up performance for boards that have many embeds (e.g /vt/) if turned off
Cover Preview: Show preview of supported links on hover.
Embedding: Embed supported services. Note: Some services don't work on HTTPS.
Floating Embeds: Embed content in a frame that remains in place when the page is scrolled.

Filtered Backlinks: When enabled, shows backlinks to filtered posts with a line-through decoration. Otherwise, hides the backlinks.
Filter in Native Catalog: Apply 4chan X filters in native catalog.
MD5 Quick Filter Notifications: Show notification when quick filtering MD5s using the button or keybind.
MD5 Quick Filter in the Catalog: Quick filter by MD5 when clicking a thumbnail in the catalog and holding Shift. Disabling falls back on just hiding the thread.
MD5 Quick Filter in Threads: Quick filter by MD5 when clicking a thumbnail in a thread while holding shift.
Recursive Hiding: Hide replies of hidden posts, recursively.
Thread Hiding Buttons: Add buttons to hide entire threads.
Reply Hiding Buttons: Add buttons to hide single replies.
Stubs: Show stubs of hidden threads / replies.
Filter Reason: Show the reason the post was hidden in the stub. If disabled, you can hover over the stub to see the reason.

Image Hover: Show full image / video on mouseover.
Image Hover in Catalog: Show full image / video on mouseover in 4chan-XZ catalog.
Gallery: Adds a simple and cute image gallery. Has more options in the gallery menu.
WEBM Metadata: Add link to fetch title metadata from webm videos.
Reveal Spoiler Thumbnails: Replace spoiler thumbnails with the original image.
Replace GIF: Replace gif thumbnails with the actual image.
Replace JPG: Replace jpg thumbnails with the actual image.
Replace PNG: Replace png thumbnails with the actual image.
Replace WEBM: Replace webm, mp4, and ogv thumbnails with the actual video. Probably will degrade browser performance ;)
Image Prefetching: Add a shortcut icon to the header to turn on image preloading.
Fappe Tyme: Hide posts without images when header menu item is checked. *hint* *hint*
Werk Tyme: Hide all post images when header menu item is checked.
Autoplay: Videos begin playing immediately when opened.
Restart when Opened: Restart GIFs and WebMs when you hover over or expand them.
Show Controls: Show controls on videos expanded inline.
Click Passthrough: Clicks on videos trigger your browser's default behavior. Videos can be contracted with button / dragging to the left.
Allow Sound: Open videos with the sound unmuted.
Mouse Wheel Volume: Adjust volume of videos with the mouse wheel over the thumbnail/filename/gallery.
Loop in New Tab: Loop videos opened in their own tabs.
Volume in New Tab: Apply 4chan-XZ mute and volume settings to videos opened in their own tabs.
Enable sound posts: Enable loading audio from [sound=] file names. This audio is fetched from third parties.

Menu: Add a drop-down menu to posts.
Report Link: Add a report link to the menu.
Copy Text Link: Add a link to copy the post's text.
Thread Hiding Link: Add a link to hide entire threads.
Reply Hiding Link: Add a link to hide single replies.
Delete Link: Add post and image deletion links to the menu.
Archive Link: Add an archive link to the menu.
Edit Link: Add a link to edit the image in Tegaki, /i/'s painting program. Requires Quick Reply.
Download Link: Add a download with original filename link to the menu.

Thread Updater: Fetch and insert new replies. Has more options in the header menu and the "Advanced" tab.
Unread Count: Show the unread posts count in the tab title.
Quoted Title: Change the page title to reflect you've been quoted.
Hide Unread Count at (0): Hide the unread posts count in the tab title when it reaches 0.
Unread Favicon: Show a different favicon when there are unread posts.
Unread Line: Show a line to distinguish read posts from unread ones.
Remember Last Read Post: Remember how far you've read after you close the thread.
Scroll to Last Read Post: Scroll back to the last read post when reopening a thread.
Unread Line in Index: Show a line between read and unread posts in threads in the index.
Remove Thread Excerpt: Replace the excerpt of the thread in the tab title with the board title.
IP Count in Stats: Display the unique IP count in the thread stats.
Page Count in Stats: Display the page count in the thread stats.
Purge Position: Update stats more often and add purge position when a thread is close to getting purged, for anons who manage general threads.
Updater and Stats in Header: Places the thread updater and thread stats in the header instead of floating them.
Thread Watcher: Bookmark threads. Has more options in the thread watcher menu.
Fixed Thread Watcher: Makes the thread watcher scroll with the page.
Persistent Thread Watcher: The thread watcher will be visible when the page is loaded.
Mark New IPs: Label each post from a new IP with the thread's current IP count.
Reply Pruning: Add option in header menu to hide old replies in long threads. Activated by default in stickies.
Prune All Threads: Activate Reply Pruning by default in all threads.

Quick Reply: All-in-one form to reply, create threads, automate dumping and more.
Persistent QR: The Quick reply won't disappear after posting.
Auto Hide QR: Automatically hide the quick reply when posting.
Open Post in New Tab: Open new threads in a new tab, and open replies in a new tab if you're not already in the thread.
Remember QR Size: Remember the size of the Quick reply.
Remember Spoiler: Remember the spoiler state, instead of resetting after posting.
Randomize Filename: Set the filename to a random timestamp within the past year. Disabled on /f/.
Show New Thread Option in Threads: Show the option to post a new / different thread from inside a thread.
Show Upload Progress: Track progress of file uploads as percentage in submit button.
Cooldown: Indicate the remaining time before posting again.
Posting Success Notifications: Show notifications on successful post creation or file uploading.
Auto-load captcha: Automatically load the captcha in the QR even if your post is empty.
Post on Captcha Completion: Submit the post immediately when the captcha is completed.
Avoid OffscreenCanvas: Do not use OffscreenCanvas when converting images, workaround for this LibreWolf bug
Force Noscript Captcha: Use the non-Javascript fallback captcha even if Javascript is enabled.
Pass Link: Add a 4chan Pass login link to the bottom of the page.

Bottom Backlinks: Place backlinks at the bottom of posts.
Inline Cross-thread Quotes Only: Don't inline quote links when the posts are visible in the thread.
Quote Hash Navigation: Include an extra link after quotes for autoscrolling to quoted posts.
Forward Hiding: Hide original posts of inlined backlinks.
Resurrect Quotes: Link dead quotes to the archives, and support inlining/previewing of archive links like quote links.
Mark Quotes of You: Add '(You)' to quotes linking to your posts.
Highlight Posts Quoting You: Highlights any posts that contain a quote to your post.
Quote Threading: Add option in header menu to thread conversations.

Scroll into view: Scroll down when expanding images to bring the full image into view.
Expand spoilers: Expand all images along with spoilers.
Expand videos: Expand all images also expands videos.
Expand from here: Expand all images only from current position to thread end.
Expand thread only: In index, expand all images only within the current thread.
Advance on contract: Advance to next post when contracting an expanded image.

Current Board: Only show watched threads from the current board.
Auto Update Thread Watcher: Periodically check status of watched threads.
Auto Watch Reply: Automatically watch threads you reply to.
Show Page: Show what page watched threads are on.
Show Unread Count: Show number of unread posts in watched threads.
Show Site Prefix: When multiple sites are shown in the thread watcher, add a prefix to board names to distinguish them.
Require OP Quote Link: For purposes of thread watcher highlighting, only consider posts with a quote link to the OP as replies to the OP.

Show Replies: Show replies in the index, and also in the catalog if "Catalog hover expand" is checked.
Catalog Hover Expand: Expand the comment and show more details when you hover over a thread in the catalog.
Catalog Hover Toggle: Turn "Catalog hover expand" on and off by clicking in the catalog.
Pin Watched Threads: Move watched threads to the start of the index.
Anchor Hidden Threads: Move hidden threads to the end of the index.
Refreshed Navigation: Refresh index when navigating through pages.

Toggle header: Toggle the auto-hide option of the header.
Open empty QR: Open QR without post number inserted.
Open QR: Open QR with post number inserted.
Add new post: Add new post to the QR dump list.
Update: Update the thread / refresh the index.
Mark thread read: Mark thread read from index (requires "Unread Line in Index").
Next Gallery Image: Go to the next image in gallery mode.
Previous Gallery Image: Go to the previous image in gallery mode.
Advance Gallery: Go to next image or, if Autoplay is off, play video.
Open front page: Open front page in a new tab.
Paged mode: Open the index in paged mode.
Infinite scrolling mode: Open the index in infinite scrolling mode.
All pages mode: Open the index in all threads mode.
Open catalog: Open the catalog of the current board.
Search form: Focus the search field on the board index.
Quick Filter MD5: Add the MD5 of the selected image to the filter list.
Previous Post Quoting You: Scroll to the previous post that quotes you.
Next Post Quoting You: Scroll to the next post that quotes you.

Beep: Beep on new post to completely read thread.
Beep Quoting You: Beep on new post quoting you.
Auto Scroll: Scroll updated posts into view. Only enabled at bottom of page.
Bottom Scroll: Always scroll to the bottom, not the first new post. Useful for event threads.
Optional Increase: Increase the intervals between updates on threads without new posts.
